summary: Build practical exposure assessment, sampling, and control skills in industrial hygiene. Enroll in TrainingCred’s 5-day advanced course.
lede: Industrial hygiene training helps workplace health professionals assess exposure hazards and plan practical controls. It is for industrial hygienists, occupational health and safety specialists, managers, engineers, and nurses who support workplace health programs, and develops skills to recognize chemical, physical, biological, and ergonomic risks, select sampling and monitoring approaches, interpret exposure findings against applicable limits, and report prioritized controls.
audienceIntro: This industrial hygiene training is designed for professionals who already support workplace health programs and need deeper, field-ready capability in exposure assessment, sampling, and hazard control.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of workplace safety or OEHS processes, basic familiarity with hazards in industrial operations, and comfort reading simple exposure data tables. No coding or programming is required. Prior exposure to air sampling, direct reading instruments, or occupational exposure limits is helpful but not mandatory. This course assumes you can engage with field measurements, interpret sampling outputs, and contribute to industrial hygiene action plans at an advanced operational level.
